title: Framework project (project.json next to minigames/, maps/, presets/, pool.json)

namespace.description: Datapack namespace; also prefixes objectives, tags and storages.

output.description: Output datapack dir, relative to the project dir. Overwritten on every build.

lib_prefix.description: Namespace of the vendored function library.

players.description: Player counts the selector is compiled for (a candidate list per count).

dimension.description: Name of the void dimension the pack defines (<ns>:<dimension>).

base_y.description: World y of each map's local y = 0.

slot_spacing.description: Distance along x between map slots (must exceed the largest map + margin).

objective.description: Objective name without the namespace prefix (<ns>.<objective>).

tiles_per_tick.description: Override; default = config max_blocks_per_tick / tile volume.

end_delay_ticks.description: Ticks between the round ending and teardown.

tests.description: Dir of *.test.json copied into the built pack.
